title: Observability and controllability for the Schrödinger equation on polyhedra
summary: We consider the observability and controllability for the Schrödinger equation on polyhedra. We show that for the Schrödinger equation on convex polyhedra in $\mathbb{R}^d\,(d\geq2)$, when the initial data possess $H^s\,(s>d/2)$ regularity, observability and controllability hold, with the control region being an arbitrary nonempty open neighborhood of the singular set of the boundary, which is the same as the control region for eigenfunctions.
